bounds.domain: Two owner identities and one child.
bounds.scope: Finite ownership projection with conditional close progress and real process conformance.

assumptions: Checked formula in api_native_supervisor: CloseCompletes = (spawn.weakFair(s) and receipt.weakFair(s) and startComplete.weakFair(s) and launchFailure.weakFair(s) and drainStop.weakFair(s) and finishClose.weakFair(s)).implies( s.closeRequested.leadsTo(s.closed))
The property is conditional on its written model fairness and environmental premises. Real scheduler fairness, provider completion and implementation refinement are not proved.

fairness: CloseCompletes assumes start/receipt callbacks settle, successful child termination, fair supervisor continuation and close-wait scheduling. A permanently hung or failed stop callback can prevent close and remains outside this progress claim.
